description: This file is a Java configuration class for setting up auditing and a security filter in a Spring Boot application. It defines beans for auditor provider and user authentication filter, enabling JPA auditing and registering a web filter for API endpoints.

classes.name: AuditConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class for setting up JPA auditing and registering an authentication filter.

methods.name: myAuditorProvider
methods.description: Defines a bean that supplies the current auditor's identity, used for auditing purposes.

methods.name: authUserFilter
methods.description: Defines a bean that registers an application authentication user filter for API request filtering.
